FIELDS.NAME: Precision Engineering & Surveying
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Project Manager, Phone: (555) 987-6543, Email: john.smith@precisionengineering.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Precision Engineering & Surveying, we specialize in providing high-quality engineering and surveying services for residential and commercial projects. Our core operations include land surveying, construction staking, boundary surveys, and offering expert consulting for civil engineering projects. We pride ourselves on using state-of-the-art equipment maintained to the highest standards, ensuring accuracy and reliability in all our work. Our team comprises licensed professionals who engage in continuous education to stay updated with the latest industry standards and regulations. We are committed to maintaining strict adherence to safety protocols and risk management practices, allowing us to deliver projects on time and within budget while minimizing environmental impact. With a focus on client satisfaction, we work closely with stakeholders through each phase of a project, ensuring transparency and effective communication.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2023, during a routine site survey for a commercial project, our equipment was accidentally damaged due to unexpected bad weather conditions, resulting in a loss of $1,200. The equipment was promptly repaired, and operations continued without significant interruption. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Class A Safe, Grade 1, Fire Resistant Vault
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and on-site watchpersons for project locations to ensure safety and prevent unauthorized access.

FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Precision Engineering & Surveying does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations focus on providing engineering and surveying services without involvement in high-risk activities or projects that could lead to catastrophic events.
